releases.title: cut-v3 (straight cuts at 9.5 and 13.0)
releases.author: editor
releases.body: Changes from cut-v2, per director qc/cut-v2.md: the dissolves at 09.5 (shot 2->3) and 13.0 (shot 3->4) are now straight cuts, so two lanterns are never on screen at once. Kept: 06.0 straight cut, title timing, 16.0 dissolve, all timings, the sound (audio stream byte-identical to cut-v2) and the encode settings. Frames 9.4-9.6 and 12.9-13.1 checked: clean hard cuts. Measured (tools/qc.sh): 1280x720 24 fps H.264 yuv420p faststart, AAC 48k stereo, 20.000 s, clean decode, -19.8 LUFS, TP -6.0 dBFS.

releases.title: cut-v2 (straight cut at 6.0, title clear before shot 1)
releases.author: editor
releases.body: Changes from cut-v1, per director qc/cut-v1.md: (1) shot 1 -> shot 2 at 06.0 is now a straight cut (no superimposed lanterns); (2) title fade-out now 2.2-2.4 s and the dissolve into shot 1 shortened to 4 frames (2.42-2.58), so no title text over the child. Nothing else changed: picture, timings, sound and encode are the same as cut-v1. Measured (tools/qc.sh): 1280x720 24 fps H.264 yuv420p faststart, AAC 48k stereo, 20.000 s, clean decode, -19.8 LUFS, TP -6.0 dBFS. Checked frames 2.0-2.6 and 5.8-6.2: title gone by ~2.3 s, no ghost lantern at the 6.0 cut.

releases.title: cut-v1 (real picture, reworked sound)
releases.author: editor
releases.body:
First full cut: production-designer clips (picture/shots/shot1-5.mp4, 0.5 s handles used for 8-frame dissolves) + cards with EB Garamond title 'The Paper Lantern' and end card 'The End'. Timeline to shot list (T 0-2.5, 1 2.5-6, 2 6-9.5, 3 9.5-13, 4 13-16, 5 16-18, E 18-20); head fade 0.4 s, tail fade 19.2-20.
Sound changed since cut-v0 (answers qc/cut-v0.md): water is now low flow plus lapping bubbles/slaps instead of broadband noise; crickets and an early bird (stops ~8.5 s) are audible; music-box line at ~65 bpm from 6.2 s with reverb and a warm pad swelling to a high arpeggio peak at 16.0 s, resolving to a held D chord on the end card; ripple at 6.9 s.
Measured (tools/qc.sh): 1280x720 SAR1:1 24 fps CFR 480 frames, H.264 yuv420p faststart, AAC LC 48k stereo, 20.000 s both streams, clean decode, -19.8 LUFS, true peak -6.0 dBFS, no silence >0.5 s. Listened (audio-understanding, mono 22k): hears gentle lapping stream, crickets throughout, birds early, music box from ~7 s, no clicks or distortion.

releases.title: cut-v0 (PLACEHOLDER animatic)
releases.author: editor
releases.body: PLACEHOLDER animatic: all seven picture slots are labelled placeholders (no stills received yet). Real: timeline to direction/shot-list.md (T 0-2.5, 1 2.5-6, 2 6-9.5, 3 9.5-13, 4 13-16, 5 16-18, E 18-20), title and end-card text, dissolves, head/tail fades, synthesized water+evening ambience, bird, ripple at 6.9 s, music-box cue from 6.2 s peaking 16 s, resolving 18.2 s. Measured: 1280x720 SAR1:1 24 fps h264 yuv420p, AAC 48k stereo, 20.000 s, decodes clean, integrated -18.9 LUFS, true peak -6.7 dBFS (ffmpeg ebur128).
